confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from two mixed-quality sources: Expat Arrivals (EGP figures, labelled May 2026 averages) and a crowdsourced MyLifeElsewhere dataset. Expatistan and a travel-cost index were used for cocktail and wine benchmarks. Converted at roughly 48-50 EGP per USD, and no official price survey was found. Wine glass is a judgement between local bar prices and hotel-bar prices. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live listings. FX: the latest RBA observation found in search is 0.7088 USD per AUD for 2026-03-20, about eight months before the 2026-11-19 generation date, so it is probably stale and was not verified as the current figure. Re-pull the RBA F11.1 series before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Restaurant and drink anchors are based on Cairo-specific local price observations, with a beer-to-wine relationship applied where direct wine data was weak. Accommodation anchors are general model estimates for a large North African capital with a mix of budget and mid-range hotels.
